description: This file is a CMake script that monitors the state of a git repository, detects changes such as commits, and triggers reconfiguration of files accordingly. It defines macros and functions for checking git status, computing state hashes, and setting up build-time monitoring.

methods.name: GetGitState
methods.description: Retrieves current git repository state including commit hash, author info, and status.

methods.name: GitStateChangedAction
methods.description: Executes when git state changes, updating configuration files.

methods.name: HashGitState
methods.description: Computes a SHA256 hash of current git state variables.

methods.name: CheckGit
methods.description: Checks if the git repository has changed by comparing current state hash with stored hash.

methods.name: SetupGitMonitoring
methods.description: Sets up build system commands to monitor git state before building.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Main entry point that determines whether to check git state or set up monitoring based on build context.
